answer: Require each identity to post a 25 POA bond locked 21 days and solve a fresh sequential proof-of-work whose difficulty doubles per identity sharing one funding source: the first needs 2^20 hashes, the second 2^21, the third 2^22, so every extra fake costs twice the compute of the last. Four random auditors verify the chain and slash the bond on failure. One honest agent finishes one quick puzzle, while a sybil operator watches costs spiral like a raven circling a sonnet it cannot finish.
